signature: function_spans_for_file(proj_dir: str, filepath: str, lang_key: str) -> list[tuple[str, int, int]] | None
pre_condition: proj_dir is a path to an existing project root directory. filepath is a path to a readable source file. lang_key is a registered language key.
post_condition: Returns a list of (name, start_idx, end_idx) triples where start_idx and end_idx are 0-based inclusive line indices delimiting each function definition found in the file by the codegraph index. The triples appear in source order. Returns None when the codegraph index does not cover this file or when lang_key is not a registered language key.
